_doc: Flights of three (M8-T19, D85). Starfuries a station launches that are not under the player's command fly in flights of `size` (a lead and its wingmen), and so does the rest of a wing whose scenario says the player commands only a flight (`wings[].flight`). Lengths in metres. cohesion_m: a wingman farther than this from its flight's lead breaks off and rejoins; it fights again once it is back within rejoined_m. lead_spacing: with nothing to fight, the leads of a squadron's later flights form on its first AI lead, their slots this many times the formation's spacing apart.
